result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: a restaurant listing’s metadata row is overcrowded and partially overlaps the rating area, making the details hard to read.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the Tokumaru Ramen Bar details line (delivery time/fee and cuisine) is squeezed into the available space and visually collides with the rating on the right.
issues.suggestion: Increase horizontal spacing or stack the metadata and rating into separate rows/columns so the delivery info remains fully readable.
